agents_workflows.name: uv
agents_workflows.summary: uv 是一个用 Rust 编写的极速 Python 包和项目管理器，解决了传统工具在依赖解析和安装时的性能瓶颈。其核心技术在于利用 Rust 的语言特性和创新的解析算法，能够高效处理复杂的依赖关系图，比传统工具快数倍。开发者可以将其作为 pip 和 pip-tools 的直接替代品，用于快速创建虚拟环境、安装依赖包以及生成可靠的依赖锁文件，特别适合需要频繁切换项目或追求高效 CI/CD 流程的团队。
agents_workflows.summary_en: uv is an extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust that solves dependency resolution and installation bottlenecks. Its speed comes from Rust's performance advantages and a novel resolver algorithm that handles complex dependency graphs efficiently. You can use it as a drop-in replacement for pip and pip-tools to dramatically accelerate development workflows, manage virtual environments, and lock dependencies for reproducible builds across projects.
